paragraphs: Red Rover builds human resources software for K-12 school districts. The core of it is absence management, substitute scheduling and time tracking. Districts can also run professional development through it, with tracking, approvals and compliance in one place.

When a teacher is out, the system looks for a substitute on its own instead of leaving an office to make calls. Time tracking is meant to sit alongside the system a district already uses. For connecting to other district software, the company says it assigns a technician to each customer until the job is finished.

The founders spent years building and selling substitute placement software for schools before starting this company. They began the current effort in 2020. Red Rover counts more than 2,000 school districts across 49 states. Its homepage puts the number of schools that have switched above 28,000. Published case studies include one on Lake County Schools.
